headline: The newly merged Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery, now called Skydance, says it will turn itself into a technology company using AI tools.
score_reason: Major media merger with a stated AI strategy; the AI effect on jobs and content is still a plan, not a result.
importance_line: A merger that took effect on 6 Oct 2026 puts two big studios and two large news divisions under one owner that says it will use AI and unified streaming technology, but how many jobs or programmes that affects is not yet known.
summary: CNN reports that the merger of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery took effect on 6 Oct 2026, creating Skydance, whose CEO David Ellison says AI is a "force multiplier" for filmmakers and whose leaders plan to unify the streaming technology behind services such as HBO Max. The combined company has more than 200 million streaming subscribers and about $80 billion in debt, and one analyst quoted by CNN reads the promised cost savings from technology and integration as a sign of layoffs; CNN itself became part of Skydance on the same day.
notes: CNN disclosed in the article that it is now part of Skydance; kept in summary.
